title: P12 — Add interactive catalog detail previews
description:
## Dispatch packet P12
Read initiative videoml-dbc2b1 sections D05 before editing. Those are binding decisions, not suggestions.

## Repositories and edit scope
videoml-org, player
Primary paths: catalog detail template and iframe harness. Read repository AGENTS before any edits. Do not edit unrelated product code.

## Procedure
1. Read prerequisites and existing implementation at the paths above.
2. Add failing behavioral fixtures for the listed acceptance cases.
3. Implement controls/parameters/copy source/provenance and lazy framework loading; use shared example source and exact package versions. Preserve valid copyable XML/TS.
4. Run scoped checks plus required repo quality gates. Save actual commands, exit status and artifacts in an issue comment.
5. Return the diff and evidence to the primary reviewer; do not close the issue yourself.

## Acceptance
browser scrub/reset/control keyboard tests, reduced motion, missing preview errors, no card autoplay.

## Dependencies
videoml-d177d1 (P11), videoml-2779f2 (P04)

## Stop conditions
Do not guess a missing credential/account identity, bypass a failed test, substitute mocked evidence for a real smoke run, expand product scope, or change contract defaults. Report a precise blocker and return to the primary reviewer. A passing build alone is insufficient for rendering behavior.

comments.text: P12 website source now generates copyable XML for all three implemented previews with applied parameters, deterministic seed, 1280x720/30fps interval, and downloadable owned assets with relative directory instructions.
